human_summary: Students in Tongi, Gazipur, lifted a blockade of the Dhaka-Mymensingh Highway after police assured them their demand for foot overbridges would be met [ev_4be9adbfb1ccf9b1]. The blockade began around 11am and ended around 3pm [ev_4be9adbfb1ccf9b1, ev_9012296fa587ace1], following the death of 17-year-old student Yasin in a road accident [ev_9012296fa587ace1]. Police from Tongi East and West stations were deployed to persuade the students to withdraw [ev_68d7f18f8fe461ea]. The incident caused road congestion. Evidence is from a single source (The Daily Star). The exact crash location is not precisely specified; a city-level centroid for Tongi is used. The cause of the accident and any vehicle involvement remain unknown. No other casualties are reported, but this does not rule out unreported injuries. The alert status is 'resolved' as the blockade ended.

police personnel from Tongi East and West stations
